reason: This plugin is primarily a DeepSeek Harness integration with the external KolmoPDF service, offering PDF parsing/translation, document conversion, and cloud-task/cost utilities as first-class `kolmopdf_*` tools, so its user-facing purpose is external document-processing service access rather than automation orchestration or code generation.

summaries.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 Kolmopdf 的 PDF 解析与翻译、Markdown 转换等工具，并支持任务状态与余额/用量相关查询及 API Key 配置。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides Kolmopdf tools for PDF parsing and translation, markdown conversion, and task/balance utilities with GUI or CLI API key configuration.

capabilities: PDF parsing/translation and markdown conversion via KolmoPDF service endpoints
Conversion of markdown/zip content to DOCX, HTML, PDF, and LaTeX formats
Local file upload/download orchestration with configurable output directory handling
Credential/configuration management through GUI settings and CLI commands

reasons.code: The plugin exposes KolmoPDF tools (`kolmopdf_parse_pdf`, `kolmopdf_translate_pdf`, `kolmopdf_convert_markdown`, etc.), showing explicit dependence on an external API workflow.
It accepts and processes local PDF/Markdown/ZIP inputs, writes converted outputs, and performs upload/download/poll operations, indicating file I/O plus network transfer behavior.
Configuration supports API-key sources (settings, CLI, environment) and references credential handling and env precedence, confirming remote service authentication handling.
`dsh.bundle` declarations and DSH client/runtime dependencies indicate integration into the Harness plugin ecosystem rather than a standalone autonomous service.
